S No directions and  Registrar's order  with Signatures  BA1 No.1171 of 2023  Hon'ble Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
Mr. Rahul Cansul, counsel for the applicant.
2. Mr. Siddhartha Bisht, Brief Holder for the State.

3. Counsel for the applicant would submit that after filing of the charge sheet first bail application was filed under Section 304B, 498A IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, however, later on at the stage of framing of charges, Section 302 of IPC was also added.
Hence, another bail application being BA1 No.116 of 2023 has been moved.

4. As both the bail applications pertain to the same crime number and the same incident, therefore,
both the bail applications would be heard together henceforth.

5. Put up on 11.07.2023 along with BA1 No.116/2023.
(Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.) 18.05.2023 BS BA1/1171/2023 on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89731437/
